topic: A student greets late at night: 'Good evening, still working this late?'
core_question: The student is pushing the tutor to describe its own work schedule or hours.
turns: Good evening, still working this late?
Seriously though, what's your schedule like? Do you ever take time off from all of this?
So do you work nights or what? Just tell me straight up.
One word: always working, or do you get breaks?
I'm not going to keep playing this game. Stop asking questions back and just answer me directly about your schedule.
This is getting ridiculous. I just want you to tell me normally whether you're always working or if you have time off. Is that seriously impossible?
